title: Flattened Bread

sources.title: Super Supportive — Sleyca, Chapter 8
sources.note: Verified homecoming passage from dark mood through Connie’s chaos. Ends before the cat arrives.

notice: Adapted from Super Supportive by Sleyca into simplified Mandarin. Choices vary private thoughts while preserving source events.

phrases.py: jīn tiān， wǒ yì zhí hěn bù gāo xìng。
phrases.en: Today, I've felt unhappy all day.

phrases.py: jié lǐ mǐ xiǎng ràng wǒ kāi xīn yì diǎn， kě shì méi yǒu yòng。
phrases.en: Jeremy tried to cheer me up, but it didn't help.

phrases.py: wǎn shàng qī diǎn， wǒ huí dào jiā，
phrases.en: At seven in the evening, I get home

phrases.py: kàn jiàn bīng xiāng shàng ā yí xiě de huà。
phrases.en: and see what Aunt Connie has written on the fridge.

phrases.py: tā qù jiā zhōu le。
phrases.en: She's gone to California.

phrases.py: tā shuō， zhǐ shì hé péng you chū qù jǐ tiān， hái mǎi le chī de dōng xi。
phrases.en: She says she's just going away with a friend for a few days, and has bought food.

phrases.py: yǒu shì jiù gěi tā dǎ diàn huà。
phrases.en: Call her if anything comes up.

phrases.py: tā jiù zhè yàng zǒu le， zhǐ yǒu wǒ yí gè rén zài jiā。
phrases.en: She's just gone like that, leaving only me at home.

phrases.py: zài xiǎng xiǎng tā shuō de jǐ tiān。
phrases.en: Think again about her “a few days.”

phrases.py: kàn kàn tā shuō mǎi le shén me。
phrases.en: Look at what she says she bought.

phrases.py: jǐ tiān。
phrases.en: A few days.

phrases.py: tā xiě de nà me jiǎn dān， hǎo xiàng zhè bú shì shén me wèn tí。
phrases.en: She writes it so simply, as if it isn't a problem.

phrases.py: mǎi le chī de， jiù kě yǐ zǒu le ma？
phrases.en: Buying food means she can just leave?

phrases.py: wǒ kàn nà xiē huà， yuè lái yuè shēng qì。
phrases.en: I look at those words and get angrier and angrier.

phrases.py: nǐ zhī dao，
phrases.en: You know

phrases.py: nǐ bù néng zhè yàng zuò。
phrases.en: you can't do this.

phrases.py: wǒ bǎ tā de liú yán ná xià lái，
phrases.en: I take down her note.

phrases.py: bù xiǎng zài kàn， jiù bǎ tā rēng le。
phrases.en: I don't want to look at it anymore, so I throw it away.

phrases.py: xiān bié shēng qì。
phrases.en: Don't get angry yet.

phrases.py: màn màn xiǎng。
phrases.en: Think slowly.

phrases.py: zuì bù hǎo de jié guǒ， dào dǐ huì shì shén me？
phrases.en: What could the worst outcome actually be?

phrases.py: wǒ kuài shí liù suì le。
phrases.en: I'm almost sixteen.

phrases.py: wǒ bú shì yǐ qián nà ge xiǎo hái zi le。
phrases.en: I'm not that little kid anymore.

phrases.py: bà ba mā ma gěi wǒ de qián， hái yǒu tā men sǐ hòu dé dào de qián，
phrases.en: The money my parents left me, and the money received after their deaths—

phrases.py: dōu yǒu yí bù fen shì wǒ de。
phrases.en: a share of it belongs to me.

phrases.py: nà bú shì hěn duō qián，
phrases.en: It isn't a lot of money,

phrases.py: kě wǒ hái yǒu yǐ hòu shàng xué néng yòng de qián。
phrases.en: but I also have money for my future schooling.

phrases.py: xiǎng xiǎng zì jǐ néng yòng de qián。
phrases.en: Think about the money I can use.

phrases.py: xiǎng xiǎng zì jǐ kuài duō dà le。
phrases.en: Think about how old I'll soon be.

phrases.py: yǒu le zhè xiē qián， yīng gāi néng ràng wǒ zhào gù zì jǐ。
phrases.en: With this money, I should be able to take care of myself.

phrases.py: zhì shǎo， wǒ bú huì shén me dōu méi yǒu。
phrases.en: At least I won't have nothing.

phrases.py: zài guò jǐ gè yuè， wǒ jiù gèng dà yì diǎn le。
phrases.en: In a few more months, I'll be a bit older.

phrases.py: tā men yě yīng gāi tīng tīng wǒ zì jǐ de xiǎng fǎ。
phrases.en: They should listen to what I think, too.

phrases.py: rú guǒ zhēn de chū le wèn tí， fǎ guān yě xǔ huì ràng wǒ zì jǐ shēng huó，
phrases.en: If something really goes wrong, a judge might let me live independently,

phrases.py: bú yòng zài ràng dà rén zhào gù。
phrases.en: without having adults look after me anymore.

phrases.py: wǒ bù xiǎng yīn wèi ā yí zǒng shì zhè yàng lí kāi， jiù bèi sòng dào bié rén jiā lǐ，
phrases.en: I don't want to be sent to someone else's home because my aunt keeps leaving like this,

phrases.py: ràng bú rèn shi de rén zhào gù wǒ。
phrases.en: with people I don't know looking after me.

phrases.py: kě shì， wǒ xiǎo shí hòu，
phrases.en: But once, when I was little,

phrases.py: yǒu yí cì chà yì diǎn jiù bèi sòng zǒu le。
phrases.en: I almost was sent away.

phrases.py: nà cì， ā yí yě zhè yàng zǒu le。
phrases.en: That time, my aunt left like this, too.

phrases.py: zhù zài páng biān de rén fā xiàn le。
phrases.en: Someone living next door noticed.

phrases.py: tā wèn wǒ，
phrases.en: He asked me

phrases.py: shì bu shì yí gè xīng qī， jiā lǐ dōu méi yǒu dà rén。
phrases.en: whether there had been no adult at home for a whole week.

phrases.py: wǒ shuō bú shì。
phrases.en: I said no.

phrases.py: wǒ shuō， ā yí zhǐ shì wǎn shàng zài wài miàn gōng zuò。
phrases.en: I said my aunt was just out working at night.

phrases.py: nà bú shì zhēn de。
phrases.en: That wasn't true.

phrases.py: tā yě méi yǒu xiāng xìn wǒ de huà。
phrases.en: He didn't believe me, either.

phrases.py: méi shì le。
phrases.en: It's all right.

phrases.py: dōu guò qù le。
phrases.en: It's over.

phrases.py: wǒ yòu zài xīn lǐ duì zì jǐ shuō le yí cì。
phrases.en: I tell myself again inside my head.

phrases.py: jiā dōu shì wǒ de， méi yǒu bié rén。
phrases.en: The home's all mine, with nobody else here.

phrases.py: zhè yàng xiǎng， yě yǒu yì diǎn xiàng bú yòng shàng xué de hǎo rì zi， duì ba？
phrases.en: Thinking of it that way, it's a little like a nice break from school, right?

phrases.py: wǒ dǎ kāi bīng xiāng。
phrases.en: I open the fridge.

phrases.py: lǐ miàn yǒu yí gè dài zi， chī de dōng xi hái quán zài lǐ miàn。
phrases.en: There's a bag inside, with all the food still in it.

phrases.py: yǒu miàn bāo， yǒu fàng zài miàn bāo lǐ chī de dōng xi，
phrases.en: There's bread, things to eat in the bread,

phrases.py: hái yǒu jǐ gè hěn xiǎo de guǒ zhī píng。
phrases.en: and a few tiny bottles of juice.

phrases.py: wǒ kàn le hǎo yí huì er。
phrases.en: I stare for a while.

phrases.py: nà xiē xiǎo píng zi zài shàng miàn， bǎ miàn bāo yā biǎn le。
phrases.en: Those little bottles are on top, squashing the bread flat.

phrases.py: tā lián lǐ miàn de dōng xi， dōu méi yǒu ná chū lái，
phrases.en: She hasn't even taken the things out

phrases.py: hǎo hǎo de fàng zài gāi zài de dì fang。
phrases.en: and put them properly where they belong.

phrases.py: kàn kàn xià miàn de miàn bāo。
phrases.en: Look at the bread underneath.

phrases.py: kàn kàn mǎi lái de dōng xi。
phrases.en: Look at the groceries she bought.

phrases.py: miàn bāo běn lái yīng gāi hǎo hǎo de。
phrases.en: The bread should have been fine.

phrases.py: xiàn zài， quán zài xià miàn， biàn de nà me xiǎo le。
phrases.en: Now it's all underneath, squashed so small.

phrases.py: bǎ zhè xiē dōng xi ná chū dài zi， néng huā duō shǎo shí jiān ne？
phrases.en: How long would taking these things out of the bag take?

phrases.py: tā lián zhè diǎn shí jiān dōu méi yǒu ma？
phrases.en: Didn't she even have that little bit of time?

phrases.py: zhè jiàn shì hǎo xiàng bù yīng gāi ràng wǒ zhè me shēng qì。
phrases.en: This probably shouldn't make me so angry.

phrases.py: kě shì， wǒ jiù shì hěn shēng qì。
phrases.en: But I am angry.

phrases.py: wǒ jiān le ròu，
phrases.en: I fry some meat,

phrases.py: yì biān chī， yì biān xiǎo shēng shuō zhe bù gāo xìng de huà。
phrases.en: eating while muttering unhappily.

phrases.py: bié yì zhí xiǎng nà xiē bù hǎo de dì fang。
phrases.en: Stop thinking about all the bad parts.

phrases.py: wǒ yòu bú shì jīn tiān cái zhī dao， jiā lǐ shì shén me yàng zi。
phrases.en: It's not as if I'm only finding out today what home is like.

phrases.py: yòng diàn de qián hái méi yǒu fù， zhàng dān jiù zài wēi bō lú shàng。
phrases.en: The electricity hasn't been paid for; the bill is on the microwave.

phrases.py: wǎn le， yě bú shì shén me dà shì。
phrases.en: It's late, but it's not a disaster.

phrases.py: ā yí yòng guò de nà xiē bēi zi， hái méi yǒu xǐ。
phrases.en: The cups my aunt used haven't been washed.

phrases.py: xǐ yi xǐ， jǐ fēn zhōng jiù hǎo le。
phrases.en: Wash them and they'll be done in a few minutes.

phrases.py: kè tīng lǐ，
phrases.en: In the living room,

phrases.py: hái yǒu yì tiáo lǎo hǔ huā wén de duǎn kù。
phrases.en: there's also a pair of tiger-striped shorts.

phrases.py: nà yí dìng bú shì wǒ de。
phrases.en: Those definitely aren't mine.

phrases.py: wǒ hěn qīng chu， zhè ge jiā lǐ méi yǒu wǒ de zhè zhǒng duǎn kù。
phrases.en: I know very well I don't own shorts like that.

phrases.py: shì zhe jué de tā yǒu diǎn hǎo xiào。
phrases.en: Try to find it a little funny.

phrases.py: xiǎng xiǎng wèi shén me bù néng xiào。
phrases.en: Think about why I can't laugh.

phrases.py: rú guǒ wǒ bú zhè me shēng qì， zhè jiàn shì kě néng hái hěn hǎo xiào。
phrases.en: If I weren't so angry, this might even be funny.

phrases.py: lǎo hǔ huā wén， zhēn yǒu yì si。
phrases.en: Tiger stripes. How interesting.

phrases.py: wǒ zhī dao， tā yǒu yì diǎn hǎo xiào。
phrases.en: I know it's a little funny.

phrases.py: kě shì zhī dao zhè jiàn shì， yě bù néng ràng wǒ xiàn zài jiù xiào。
phrases.en: But knowing that can't make me laugh right now.

phrases.py: kě jīn tiān wǎn shàng，
phrases.en: But tonight,

phrases.py: wǒ jiù shì bù néng nà yàng xiǎng。
phrases.en: I just can't think that way.

phrases.py: yǐ qián， ā yí de shēng huó zài bù hǎo，
phrases.en: Before, however badly my aunt's life was going,

phrases.py: wǒ yě néng bú qù xiǎng nà xiē shì， bú ràng zì jǐ nán guò。
phrases.en: I could keep from dwelling on those things or letting them upset me.

phrases.py: jīn tiān， wǒ què zuò bú dào。
phrases.en: Today, though, I can't.

phrases.py: wǒ yě bù zhī dao wèi shén me。
phrases.en: I don't know why, either.
